battery.note: Fleet starts at 60%; every 7th robot starts a shift at 22% (real low-battery units). Charging happens when an IDLE robot falls below critical, at its assigned charger slot in place; no task is interrupted, no order is lost to charging.

meta.horizon_note: 3600 s at 1.5 m/s real time; idle periods are skipped by event-driven tick jumps (no time compression)
meta.seed_note: Single seed source: site.seed in layout_spec (20261106). Scenario files override via their own seed field; this value is only the fallback for scenarios that do not declare one.
